pattern: keep groups whose derived change is negative, null rounds drop out
question: in which districts did women literacy go down from NFHS-4 to NFHS-5
gold_sql: SELECT "District" FROM district_health_factsheet WHERE "District" <> 'State Total' GROUP BY "District" HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-5' THEN "Women age 15-49 years who are literate (%)" END) < MAX(CASE WHEN "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-4' THEN "Women age 15-49 years who are literate (%)" END) ORDER BY "District"
sql_duckdb: WITH literacy_nfhs4 AS (SELECT "District", "Women age 15-49 years who are literate (%)" AS literacy_nfhs4 FROM "district_health_factsheet" WHERE "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-4'), literacy_nfhs5 AS (SELECT "District", "Women age 15-49 years who are literate (%)" AS literacy_nfhs5 FROM "district_health_factsheet" WHERE "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-5') SELECT nfhs5."District", nfhs5.literacy_nfhs5 - nfhs4.literacy_nfhs4 AS literacy_change FROM literacy_nfhs5 AS nfhs5 JOIN literacy_nfhs4 AS nfhs4 ON nfhs5."District" = nfhs4."District" WHERE nfhs5.literacy_nfhs5 < nfhs4.literacy_nfhs4

in which districts did women literacy go down from NFHS-4 to NFHS-5
attempts.response:
```sql
WITH literacy_nfhs4 AS (
    SELECT "District", "Women age 15-49 years who are literate (%)" AS literacy_nfhs4
    FROM "district_health_factsheet"
    WHERE "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-4'
),
literacy_nfhs5 AS (
    SELECT "District", "Women age 15-49 years who are literate (%)" AS literacy_nfhs5
    FROM "district_health_factsheet"
    WHERE "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-5'
)
SELECT 
    nfhs5."District",
    nfhs5.literacy_nfhs5 - nfhs4.literacy_nfhs4 AS literacy_change
FROM 
    literacy_nfhs5 nfhs5
JOIN 
    literacy_nfhs4 nfhs4 ON nfhs5."District" = nfhs4."District"
WHERE 
    nfhs5.literacy_nfhs5 < nfhs4.literacy_nfhs4;
```
